selection_principle: Hard v1 may add only deterministic, text-only, payload-preserving structural compactions to Normal. It must not force a retention target or rank documents by intrinsic Quality.

candidate_contracts.trigger: explicit license marker in a contiguous prefix comment header
candidate_contracts.non_trigger: ordinary documentation, code with a header, or a header without explicit license evidence
candidate_contracts.postcondition: residual chunk passes the same minimum payload boundary as Stage B

candidate_contracts.trigger: explicit license marker in a self-contained contiguous comment block
candidate_contracts.non_trigger: ordinary comments, API documentation, or code-bearing comment blocks
candidate_contracts.postcondition: residual chunk passes the same minimum payload boundary as Stage B

candidate_contracts.trigger: long exact repeated span with a stable representative occurrence
candidate_contracts.non_trigger: shared short phrases, legitimate API/test matrices, or text whose residual fails payload validity
candidate_contracts.postcondition: only the nonrepresentative span is removed and every residual chunk remains valid

excluded_from_hard_v1.reason: A near-duplicate threshold alone cannot distinguish a small but decisive semantic difference from non-payload variation.
Known-high-quality reference false positives and proxy evidence do not establish a deterministic removal boundary.
Depends on source-backed metadata rather than the domain-general text-only Hard v1 surface.
Requires a separately versioned complete-artifact adapter and is deferred from the initial domain-general Hard profile.

claim_boundary: This inventory defines the candidate scope for a development-only stronger structural profile. It may not be used for production curation or downstream claims until N4 and confirmatory validation close.
